title: Refutation data
statement: A refutation data package consists of natural-number coefficients $C_1,C_2,C_3,B$, natural-number degrees $c_1,c_2,c_3,b$, and a language $R$ over Boolean lists. The fields are designated, respectively, for the two block-length bounds, the refutation-length bound, the inner-block bound, and the refutation relation.
hypotheses_covered: $R$ is a language over Boolean lists
